recommendations.overall_recommendation_summary: To enhance your candidacy for the Junior Java Backend Developer position, focus on improving the clarity and organization of your CV, adding measurable results to your projects, and developing skills related to REST APIs and Spring Boot.

cv_improvement_recommendations.title: Organize Skills Section
cv_improvement_recommendations.reason: The skills section lacks organization and clarity, which affects the overall readability of your CV.
cv_improvement_recommendations.evidence: The CV quality analysis indicates that the skills section is not clearly organized, impacting the technical skills clarity score.

recommended_actions.action_description: Organize your skills into categories such as Programming Languages, Tools, and Frameworks to improve clarity.
recommended_actions.expected_impact: This will enhance the readability of your CV and make it easier for recruiters to identify your relevant skills.

cv_improvement_recommendations.title: Include Measurable Results
cv_improvement_recommendations.reason: Your CV currently lacks measurable results or achievements, which could significantly enhance its impact.
cv_improvement_recommendations.evidence: The CV quality analysis notes that no measurable results or outcomes are provided for your projects.

recommended_actions.action_description: For each project, include specific outcomes or results achieved, such as performance improvements or user engagement metrics.
recommended_actions.expected_impact: This will demonstrate the impact of your work and strengthen your CV.

cv_improvement_recommendations.title: Improve Contact Information Formatting
cv_improvement_recommendations.reason: Inconsistent formatting of contact information can detract from the professionalism of your CV.
cv_improvement_recommendations.evidence: The CV quality analysis highlights inconsistent formatting in the contact information section.

recommended_actions.action_description: Ensure that your contact information is consistently formatted, including font size and style.
recommended_actions.expected_impact: This will improve the overall presentation of your CV.

missing_required_skills_recommendations.evidence: The job posting requires knowledge of REST API basics, which is not mentioned in your CV.

recommended_actions.action_description: Consider taking an online course or tutorial on REST APIs to build foundational knowledge.
recommended_actions.expected_impact: This will help you meet the job requirements and improve your candidacy for the position.

technical_development_recommendations.evidence: The job posting lists Spring Boot as a nice-to-have skill, which is not present in your CV.

recommended_actions.action_description: If you have experience with Spring Boot, add it to your CV with relevant project evidence. If not, consider learning it through online resources.
recommended_actions.expected_impact: This will enhance your technical profile and align you better with the job requirements.

technical_development_recommendations.evidence: Docker is listed as a nice-to-have skill in the job posting but is not mentioned in your CV.

recommended_actions.action_description: Consider taking a course on Docker to understand containerization and its applications in software development.
recommended_actions.expected_impact: This will improve your technical skill set and make you a more attractive candidate.

technical_development_recommendations.evidence: Jenkins is mentioned as a nice-to-have skill in the job posting, which is not reflected in your CV.

recommended_actions.action_description: If you have experience with Jenkins, add it to your CV. If not, consider learning about it through tutorials or courses.
recommended_actions.expected_impact: This will enhance your profile and align with the job requirements.

soft_skills_recommendations.title: Evidencing Communication Skills
soft_skills_recommendations.reason: While you mention strong communication skills, there is limited evidence in your CV to support this claim.
soft_skills_recommendations.evidence: The CV quality analysis indicates that soft skills are not clearly evidenced.

recommended_actions.action_description: Include specific examples from your projects where you collaborated with others or communicated effectively.
recommended_actions.expected_impact: This will provide concrete evidence of your communication skills and enhance your CV.
